item.mng: čoγtu ulaγan erlig-ün dayisun-u neretü dandr-a-yin qaγan
item.coloph: nom-un qaγan blam-a-yin ǰarliq-un gerel kiged, bhota pandita-yin ǰarliq-luγ-a, kümün-ü erketü ananda badir-a-yin ǰarliq kiged, dbongungson noyan altan suyurqaqsan-dur sitüǰü, sakyalig-du-un ayaq-γ-a tegimlig čandr-a-sri pandita nayiraγulǰu yeke pandita čandr-a kirti-luγ-a yarlung-un kirti dhvaǰa balbo-yin orun-u yabudal yambu-yin balgad-tur orčiγulbai, mongγol-un kelen.dür toyin čorǰi orčiγulbai,

item.mng: <čoγtu> ulaγan erlig-ün / dayisun neretü dandir-a-yin qaγan.
item.coloph: nom-un qaγan lam-a-yin ǰarliγ-un gerel kiged, botr-a / banḍida-yin <ǰarliγ>-luγ-a, kümün-ü erketü ananda badir-a-yin ǰarliγ kiged, kün kṣo"n noyan altan soyurqaγsan-tur / sitüǰü, šaky-a-lig-ud-<un> ayaγ-q-a tegimlig čanḓir-a siri ba<ndi>-ḓa nayiraγulǰu yeke paṇḍḓa çandr-a kiirti/-luγ-a yarlung-un kiirti <duvaǰa> balbova oron-u yabudal yambuyin balγad-tur orčiγulbai mongγol-un kelen-tür toyin <čorǰi> orčiγulbai. , .
